foodLadder.title: Exposure ladder
foodLadder.subtitle: Where each food sits right now, and what comes next. Small steps, at your child's pace — a food that gets a no simply steps back and rests.
foodLadder.selectAChild: Choose a child to see their ladder.
foodLadder.emptyBody: A ladder tracks each food one small step at a time — from just looking at it, through touching and smelling, all the way to a full portion. If you have logged food attempts before, we can build the ladder from that history.
foodLadder.backfillFound: Added {{count}} foods to the ladder from your history.
foodLadder.backfillEmpty: No past attempts to build from yet — add a food to start a ladder.
foodLadder.pausedAll: All ladders paused. Nothing will be scheduled until you resume.
foodLadder.disclaimer: EatPal helps you keep track and keep things steady. It is not medical advice or treatment. If mealtimes are affecting your child's growth or wellbeing, a feeding therapist or your pediatrician is the right next step.

active.title: Working on
active.body: These come back around on their own schedule.

backed_off.title: Resting
backed_off.body: A meal went badly, so these have stepped back and are taking a longer break. Bring them back whenever you feel ready.

paused.title: Paused
paused.body: Nothing scheduled for these. They will wait as long as you need.

mastered.title: Made it
mastered.body: Eaten as a full portion. These are part of the rotation now.

quickLog.saved: Logged — nice work showing up for it.
quickLog.failed: Could not save that just now. Nothing was lost; try again in a moment.
quickLog.srHint: Logs this exposure at the {{rung}} step

foodLadder.scheduled: Added {{count}} step(s) to today's plan, each next to a safe food.
foodLadder.nothingDue: Nothing is due today — everything is resting or already planned.
foodLadder.scheduleFailed: Could not build today's plan just now. Nothing was changed.
foodLadder.dueTodayBody: What's being asked today, and one tap to say how it went.

mastery.title: That one's made it
mastery.body: Nice. When you're ready, here's what pairs naturally with it — each one would start gently, served alongside the food they just got comfortable with. No rush.

weekly.title: The ladder this week
weekly.headline: {{name}} showed up to {{exposures}} across {{foods}}.
weekly.headlineAdvanced: {{name}} showed up to {{exposures}} across {{foods}}, and {{advanced}} moved up a step.
weekly.headlineEmpty: No steps were logged this week — {{name}}'s ladder is right where you left it.
weekly.movedUp: Moved up: {{foods}}. Steps like that come from turning up, not from finishing a plate.
weekly.mastered_one: {{foods}} reached the top of the ladder this week and joined the regular rotation.
weekly.mastered_other: {{foods}} reached the top of the ladder this week and joined the regular rotation.
weekly.held: Held steady: {{foods}}. Staying on the same step is how a food becomes familiar — that is the work, not a pause in it.
weekly.backedOff: Eased back: {{foods}}. Dropping to a gentler step after a hard meal is the plan working, and it comes back around after a rest.
weekly.noAdvancement: No steps changed this week. That is what most weeks look like — repeat exposure at the same step is what builds familiarity, and {{name}} kept showing up for it.
weekly.nothingLogged: Nothing was logged on the ladder this week, and that is allowed. Ladders keep their place, so you can pick up exactly where things stood whenever you are both ready.
weekly.masteredTotal_one: {{count}} food has been mastered so far.
weekly.masteredTotal_other: {{count}} foods have been mastered so far.

report.dialogBody: A one-page summary of what you have been working on: where each food sits, how it got there, and which preparations went best. It is built on your device and saved to your downloads — nothing is uploaded.
report.rangeInvalid: Pick an end date on or after the start date.
report.empty: No ladder activity in that range yet. Try a wider range.
report.failed: Could not build the summary. Please try again.
report.title: Exposure ladder summary
report.totalsLine: {{foods}} foods · {{attempts}} logged attempts · {{mastered}} at a full portion
report.startedAt: At the start of this range
report.noPreps: No preparation was recorded often enough to compare.
report.noAttempts: No attempts logged in this range.
report.generatedNote: Generated on this device by EatPal. Not uploaded or shared automatically.

plating.title: One pan, four plates
plating.subtitle: Cook it once, then plate it per child. Anything taken off is listed so you can see what changed and why.
plating.blockedBody: Something {{name}} cannot have is part of the dish itself and cannot be taken off. Serve {{name}} something else tonight.
plating.emptyBody: Nothing here works for {{name}} tonight — everything would come off the plate.

reasons.cannotHoldBack: cannot be taken off — it is the dish

safeFood.title: {{food}} has been going differently
safeFood.body: Nothing here needs fixing today. This is just what the last couple of weeks looked like for {{food}}, in case it is useful to know now rather than later.

observations.decliningAcceptance: Accepted less often lately than {{food}} usually is — about {{recent}} of servings, against {{baseline}} before.
observations.risingRefusals: Turned down more often than usual — about {{recent}} of servings, against {{baseline}} before.
observations.overServed: Served {{shortCount}} times this week and {{longCount}} times over four weeks.

safeFood.backupBody: {{food}} works, so something close to it has a good chance too. Starting a ladder for {{target}} keeps {{food}} as the anchor beside it — no pressure on either one.
safeFood.backupAdded: {{target}} added to the ladder, paired with {{food}}.
safeFood.backupFailed: Could not add that to the ladder. Please try again.
safeFood.backupNone: No close match to suggest yet — adding more foods helps us find one.
safeFood.rotationBody: {{food}} is on the menu a lot at the moment. Spacing it out can help it stay interesting.
safeFood.dismissed: We won't bring {{food}} up again for a while.
